toegepas.blok: Drie punte om na drama te kyk
toegepas.voor: 'n Lofdig met woorde, stem en lyf voor 'n gehoor is ook drama.
toegepas.na: 'n Lofdig wat met woorde, stem en lyf voor 'n gehoor voorgedra word, is ook drama.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The noun phrase has no verb linking the poem to words, voice and body; a relative clause makes it read naturally.
toegepas.fout: The noun phrase 'n Lofdig met woorde, stem en lyf voor 'n gehoor' has no verb and reads telegraphic.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The relative clause with 'voorgedra word' says what the lesson already says a praise poem is, and reads naturally.

toegepas.voor: Dit kan wees wanneer 'n nuwe leier sy plek inneem.
toegepas.na: So 'n geleentheid kan wees wanneer 'n nuwe leier sy plek inneem.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Dit' now follows the naming sentence, so it no longer clearly refers to the occasions mentioned two sentences earlier.
toegepas.fout: 'Dit' follows the naming sentence and can be read as pointing to the naming rather than the occasions.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'So 'n geleentheid' restores the reference to the occasions without changing what is said.

toegepas.voor: Vandag klink 'n lofdig ook by ander groot dae soos gradeplegtighede.
toegepas.na: Vandag word 'n lofdig ook by ander groot geleenthede soos gradeplegtighede voorgedra.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'n Lofdig klink by ... dae' is unidiomatic (a day takes 'op', and a poem is recited, not 'sounded'); this matches the block's own 'geleenthede'.
toegepas.fout: 'n Lofdig klink by ... dae' is an unidiomatic verb and preposition pairing.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Word ... voorgedra by ander groot geleenthede' is natural, matches the block's own wording and keeps the same example and qualifier.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Oor en oor' is a calque of English 'over and over'.
toegepas.fout: 'Oor en oor' copies English 'over and over'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Keer op keer' is the natural Afrikaans expression and keeps the meaning exactly.

toegepas.voor: Dit word in teaters en skoolsale gespeel, en soms by feeste.
toegepas.na: Dit word in teaters, in skoolsale en soms by feeste opgevoer.
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS: no comma before 'en' between parts of one sentence; 'opgevoer' is the usual verb for staging a play.
toegepas.fout: A comma before 'en' between parts of one sentence, against the AWS 2017.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal removes the comma, and 'opgevoer' is the usual verb for staging a play and matches the glossary entry for kinderteater.

toegepas.voor: Die storie is dikwels 'n bekende storie of 'n volksverhaal.
toegepas.na: Die storie is dikwels 'n bekende een of 'n volksverhaal.
toegepas.rede_vinder: Avoids repeating 'storie' twice in one short sentence.
toegepas.fout: 'Storie' is repeated twice in one short sentence.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'n Bekende een' removes the repetition with no change in meaning.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Helder' for costumes is an English-style collocation; 'kleurryk' is the natural Afrikaans word.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Kleurryke kostuums' is the natural Afrikaans collocation for the same thing.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Reguit praat' suggests speaking frankly; 'direk' says the players address the audience.
toegepas.fout: 'Reguit met die gehoor praat' can read as speaking frankly to the audience.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Direk' says unambiguously that the players address the audience, which is what is meant.

toegepas.voor: klap jy hande en daardie applous
toegepas.na: klap jy hande, en daardie applous
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS: comma before 'en' joining two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: No comma before 'en' joining two sentences with their own subject and verb ('jy klap', 'applous sê').
toegepas.rede_keurder: The AWS 2017 comma is required here.

toegepas.voor: vra die spelers soms dat die kinders antwoord of saamsing
toegepas.na: vra die spelers die kinders soms om te antwoord of saam te sing
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Iemand vra om te ...' is the natural construction; the 'dat' clause is wooden.
toegepas.fout: 'Vra ... dat die kinders antwoord of saamsing' is a wooden construction.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Vra die kinders soms om te antwoord of saam te sing' is the natural construction, with the same people, actions and qualifier.

laat_vaar.voor: dra 'n lofdigter 'n lofdig voor by belangrike geleenthede
laat_vaar.na: dra 'n lofdigter by belangrike geleenthede 'n lofdig voor
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The separable particle 'voor' belongs at the end of the clause in Afrikaans.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Placing the prepositional phrase after the particle is normal Afrikaans, and ending on 'belangrike geleenthede' sets up the reference two sentences later; a lateral move.

laat_vaar.voor: heet so 'n lofdigter 'n imbongi en die lofdigte izibongo
laat_vaar.na: word so 'n lofdigter 'n imbongi genoem en die lofdigte izibongo
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Heet' is literary for Grade 6; 'word ... genoem' is the everyday construction.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Heet' is fine for Grade 6, and splitting 'word ... genoem' around the first name leaves the second half ('en die lofdigte izibongo') awkwardly gapped.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A semicolon separates the two contrasted halves more clearly than a comma.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The two halves are verbless phrases, so the comma is correct, and it matches the other two list items.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Two full clauses are joined by a comma only (comma splice); a semicolon is correct.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The AWS allows a comma between short, closely linked clauses without a conjunction, so a semicolon is only a lateral move in a short list item.

laat_vaar.voor: die woorde voor, by kinderteater speel
laat_vaar.na: die woorde voor; by kinderteater speel
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Two full clauses are joined by a comma only (comma splice); a semicolon is correct.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: As with change 13, the comma between the two short clauses is acceptable Afrikaans, and the three list items stay parallel.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Oplet' takes 'op' or 'na' and sits awkwardly before a 'wat' clause; 'raaksien' fits.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Oplet wat goed gewerk het' is acceptable, and 'oplet' carries active attention where 'raaksien' means only noticing, which slightly moves the meaning of appreciation.

laat_vaar.voor: nooi self die gehoor om te reageer
laat_vaar.na: nooi self die gehoor uit om te reageer
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Inviting someone to do something is 'uitnooi om ...'; the particle is missing.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Nooi iemand om te ...' is correct Afrikaans without 'uit', and the block's heading uses the same 'nooi'.

laat_vaar.voor: bou julle klas 'n kort drama uit 'n volksverhaal
laat_vaar.na: maak julle klas 'n kort drama van 'n volksverhaal
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Avoids the clumsy double 'uit ... uit Afrika' in one sentence.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The double 'uit' is only a small blemish, and 'bou' carries the sense of building the drama over the term, which the block takes up as 'die proses'; 'maak ... van' loses it.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The block addresses the class as 'julle'; switching to 'jy' mid-block is inconsistent.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Moving from the class ('julle drama') to each learner speaking ('as jy daaroor praat') is natural, and the lesson addresses the learner as 'jy' elsewhere; a lateral move.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The bare statement reads wooden before an instruction; 'moet ... wees' links it to what follows.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Waardering is spesifiek' is a plain present-tense statement about what appreciation is, and turning it into an obligation with 'moet' shifts what the block says.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Handegeklap' is the usual Afrikaans noun for applause.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Handeklap' is a valid Afrikaans noun, so this is not a spelling fix, and a glossary definition is not reworded for a lateral choice.

na_skrywer.voor: skep prente wat die mens met
na_skrywer.na: skep woordprente wat die geëerde persoon met
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Die mens' is unclear (it can read as 'mankind' or 'one'); it means the person being honoured, and 'woordprente' is the usual term for images made with words.
na_skrywer.fout: 'Die mens' is ambiguous: it can read as 'mankind' or 'one' rather than the person being honoured.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but 'die geëerde persoon' narrows the meaning (the block says a lofdig honours a leader, a family or a person) and bundles a second word change, so the writer should fix it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Dit help mense om hulle dade en hulle herkoms te onthou.
vlae.rede: 'Hulle' is ambiguous: it can mean the honoured leader, family or person, or the people listening; fixing it needs the intended referent.
